references.name: Club Penguin
references.evidence: The 3D purple penguin character is styled directly after the avatar designs from the online game Club Penguin.

references.name: Stairway to Heaven
references.evidence: The bright blue staircase leading up into the clouds and light is a classic depiction of the Stairway to Heaven.

references.name: Emperor Penguin
references.evidence: The final frames feature real nature documentary footage of Emperor Penguins standing in a snowy landscape.

result.one_line: A surreal 3D animation of a purple penguin jumping up the Stairway to Heaven and being transported to a real-world colony of Emperor penguins.
